title: Affine comparison derived global-section vanishing for Grothendieck abelian coefficients
statement: Let X be an affine scheme in universe u and A a Grothendieck abelian category with morphisms in universe u+1 [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. For an injective A-valued sheaf I on X_et [def-sp-injective-resolutions], form the comparison pullback nu_X^* I [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For every natural number q, its (q+1)-st right derived global sections on X_proet are zero. Global sections mean evaluation at the identity object X/X; no direct-image sheaf is mentioned.

source.place: Lemma 61.19.4, finite Cech proof; categorical extension using finite products and exact filtered colimits

proof.text: Import the existing affineProEt_finite_refinement and affineProEt_cechNerve helpers from AffineComparisonInjectiveVanishing, made public in place without changing their statements or proofs. They give finite refinements of covering sieves on affine ind-etale objects and closure of repeated nerve terms in that basis.
Choose a simultaneous etale presentation of the finite cover. This keeps the two-limit geometric route of the unit and descends no coefficient data.

The exact sheafification adjunction makes the underlying etale presheaf of I injective. Apply the cofree categorical Cech contraction at every stage, and transfer exactness through the presentation by exact filtered colimits and finite products.
Apply the categorical finite-cover Cech criterion to the comparison pullback sheaf. The terminal pro-etale object of affine X is affine ind-etale, so its positive right derived evaluation is zero.

proof_origin.place: The two-limit finite Cech proof, assembled in Lean with categorical products, AB5, cofree injective contraction and dimension shifting. The one unproved local-zero sheafification obligation is stage3-categorical-finite-cover-local-zero. Repair of the returned duplicate helpers: reuse the existing geometric theorems from AffineComparisonInjectiveVanishing after exposing them in place; no duplicate proof remains.

tool_uses_requested.lem-cbc-affine-etale-cech-presentation: Coefficient-free geometric construction reused from the comparison unit; the original proper-base-change two-limit route is retained.

theorem isZero_rightDerived_globalSections_comparisonUpperStar_of_isAffine
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A) [Injective I] (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) A ⋙
      (evaluation X.ProEtᵒᵖ A).obj (op (MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ (𝟙 X)
        (MorphismProperty.id_mem _ X)))).rightDerived (q + 1)).obj
      ((comparisonUpperStar A X).obj I))
